Plot:
Set in Canada, the story follows Annie Jacobson, a 17-year-old New York City teenager who discovers she has inherited a private lake island from her estranged grandfather. Upon visiting the island, she uncovers buried family secrets and a girl who looks exactly like her late mother, setting off a search for the truth.

Review:
Sterling Point is an elevated and melancholic young adult drama that beautifully explores identity, family secrets, and sisterhood. With powerful performances, luxurious pacing, and a nostalgic atmosphere, the series captures the essence of 1990s teen classics while delivering a deeply emotional and mysterious modern story.
